title: Stenographer, UDC and More – 37 Posts
location: Lucknow, Allahabad, Jabalpur, Dehradun, Patna, Ranchi
age_limit: Maximum age should not exceed 56 years on the closing date
summary: The Debts Recovery Appellate Tribunal (DRAT), Allahabad invites applications from suitable candidates for appointment to various Group-B and Group-C posts on a deputation basis. Eligible officials under the Central Government, State Governments, or Courts/Tribunals may apply through proper channel before the deadline.
eligibility_bullets: Open to officers under the Central Government, State Government, or Courts/Tribunals holding analogous posts on a regular basis or meeting specific years of service in feeder grades.
Maximum age limit is 56 years as on the closing date.
Applicants must forward their applications through proper channel along with attested copies of APARs for the last five years and vigilance clearance certificates.
how_to_apply_steps: Review the eligibility criteria and ensure you meet the requirements for the desired post.
Fill out the application form in the prescribed pro-forma provided in the official notification (Annexure-I and Annexure-II).
Attach attested photocopies of APARs for the last five years and the required certificates from the parent department.

Send the complete application through proper channel to 'The Secretary/Registrar, Debts Recovery Appellate Tribunal, First Floor, E-10 B Building, BSNL Premises, Patrika Marg, Civil Lines, Prayagraj -211001 (U.P.)' on or before 28.12.2026 by 05:30 PM.
